description: This file contains Bash shell script code that defines automated tests for Git push operations, including different scenarios such as standard push, atomic push, non-fast-forward push, forced push, and cleanup procedures.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success for a specific Git push scenario.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting failure for a specific Git push scenario.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats the expected output and saves it for comparison.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes the raw output of git commands to a user-friendly, stable format.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output for equality.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares Git references between local and remote repositories.

methods.name: filter_out_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Filters and cleans output to remove non-essential differences for comparison.
